description: The June 2026 flood is still an open emergency here, and the state cut road funding the same year. Crawford County does not need sympathy. It needs someone doing the homework and following the money. Six counties share this district, and my rule in all of them is the same: whoever is closest to the problem gets heard first.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Citizens For Hochgesang
title: Crawford County | Brad Hochgesang for State Senate
